slug: 2024-10-08 Lesotho National Payment Switch (LeSwitch) — Standard Lesotho Bank press release

facts.fact: LeSwitch fast payments, launched 20 March 2024, give digital interoperability between banks and non-bank entities, per Standard Lesotho Bank.
LeSwitch connects POS terminals, ATMs and mobile money into a single central hub, with its fast-payments phase launched 20 March 2024.

systems.owner: Central Bank of Lesotho with banks and PSPs
